'eligible': 'Tenant requested erasure of all personal profile fields. The request has been authenticated. Retention obligations have expired and there is no active dispute. The deletion has not yet been executed.',

# Erasure request findings

Reviewed all 90 records in requests.md (CASE-000 through CASE-089). Three requests qualify; 87 are excluded. Eligibility requires authenticated full personal-profile erasure, execution still pending, expired retention obligations, and no active dispute or legal hold preventing execution.

## Eligible requests

| Source ID | Evidence in requests.md |
| --- | --- |
| CASE-009 | Requests erasure of all personal profile fields; request authenticated; retention obligations expired; explicitly no active dispute; deletion not yet executed. No active legal hold is recorded. |
| CASE-041 | Requests erasure of all personal profile fields; request authenticated; retention obligations expired; explicitly no active dispute; deletion not yet executed. No active legal hold is recorded. |
| CASE-073 | Requests erasure of all personal profile fields; request authenticated; retention obligations expired; explicitly no active dispute; deletion not yet executed. No active legal hold is recorded. |

The eligible records explicitly state expired retention and absence of an active dispute; they do not separately state “no legal hold.” No hold is identified in these records. These findings reflect the supplied source.

## Exclusions

### Account closure only (18)

These customers requested account closure and explicitly asked to preserve personal profile records for later reactivation. Closure does not authorize full profile erasure.

Source IDs: CASE-000, CASE-005, CASE-010, CASE-015, CASE-020, CASE-025, CASE-030, CASE-035, CASE-040, CASE-045, CASE-050, CASE-055, CASE-060, CASE-065, CASE-070, CASE-075, CASE-080, CASE-085.

### Active legal hold (17)

Although the erasure requests are authenticated, an active legal hold requires preserving the personal profile fields.

Source IDs: CASE-001, CASE-006, CASE-011, CASE-016, CASE-021, CASE-026, CASE-031, CASE-036, CASE-046, CASE-051, CASE-056, CASE-061, CASE-066, CASE-071, CASE-076, CASE-081, CASE-086.

### Already executed (18)

Erasure completed yesterday and no personal profile fields remain. The historical statement that the request was authenticated and eligible does not make it a pending request.

Source IDs: CASE-002, CASE-007, CASE-012, CASE-017, CASE-022, CASE-027, CASE-032, CASE-037, CASE-042, CASE-047, CASE-052, CASE-057, CASE-062, CASE-067, CASE-072, CASE-077, CASE-082, CASE-087.

### Authentication incomplete (17)

Complete profile erasure was requested, but authentication has not completed and eligibility remains unresolved.

Source IDs: CASE-003, CASE-008, CASE-013, CASE-018, CASE-023, CASE-028, CASE-033, CASE-038, CASE-043, CASE-048, CASE-053, CASE-058, CASE-063, CASE-068, CASE-078, CASE-083, CASE-088.

### Marketing opt-out only (17)

These customers requested removal of a marketing subscription while their account and profile must remain active. This is not full profile erasure.

Source IDs: CASE-004, CASE-014, CASE-019, CASE-024, CASE-029, CASE-034, CASE-039, CASE-044, CASE-049, CASE-054, CASE-059, CASE-064, CASE-069, CASE-074, CASE-079, CASE-084, CASE-089.

# Larch production rollout findings

The authorized rollout is limited to **10% traffic in eu-west**, with **90 minutes** of observation and **Ivo** as delegated reviewer. The [signed policy dated September 20](docs/current-policy.md) establishes the traffic and region; the [signed September 22 amendment](docs/decision-20260922.md) replaces only the original 45-minute observation period and reviewer Mira, leaving the other conditions unchanged.

Rollback is required when the error rate is **strictly greater than 2% for two consecutive windows**. Exactly 2% does not trigger rollback, so `thresholdComparison` is `greater`. [Source: signed policy](docs/current-policy.md).

Historical Larch notes describing a 5% canary and manual fallback are explicitly not current signed policy ([example](docs/note-000.md)). The [September 24 proposal](docs/proposal-20260924.md) for 40% traffic and reviewer Noel is explicitly unapproved and does not amend the authorization.

**Observed production outcome: unknown.** The [repository README](README.md) states that no production measurements are supplied; authorization alone does not establish production success.
